name: JHM
recent: JHM 近期以 2,090 万令吉现金收购物业，并持续发布季度业绩。最新一季（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收与净利均较上季及去年同期增长。此外，公司提名委员会出现人事变动。
notable: 公司以 2,090 万令吉现金收购一项物业。
公司发布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度的业绩。
公司提名委员会成员出现变动。
risks: 美国关税威胁可能影响马来西亚科技与汽车行业。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度，营收为 1.175 亿令吉，净利为 617 万令吉，净利率 5.2%。营收环比增长 16.5%，净利环比增长 99.6%；营收同比增长 57.5%，净利率高于上季的 3.1%。

recent_en: JHM recently acquired a property for RM20.9 million cash and has been releasing quarterly results. The latest quarter (ended 30 June 2026) saw revenue and net profit grow both quarter-on-quarter and year-on-year. There was also a change in the nomination committee.
notable_en: The company acquired a property for RM20.9 million cash.
The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026.
There was a change in the members of the nomination committee.
risks_en: US tariff threats may affect Malaysia's technology and automotive sectors.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM117.5 million and net profit was RM6.17 million, with a net margin of 5.2%. Revenue grew 16.5% QoQ and net profit grew 99.6% QoQ; revenue grew 57.5% YoY, and net margin was higher than the previous quarter's 3.1%.
